greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Uthando lukaThixo uYise, ubabalo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, kunye nokubambisana koMoya oyiNgcwele makube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, usivelele ngenceba. Kristu, usivelele ngenceba. Nkosi, usivelele ngenceba.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona inqwelo-moya iqala ukubhabha, iimpondo zayo zikrazula amafu, kwaye uBenjamin Vo emi ecaleni kwakho, amehlo akhe ekhazimla ngolwazi lweenjini kunye nemfihlelo yokuphakama. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukuphakamisa amehlo akhe, engaboni nje isinyithi esibhabhayo, kodwa ebona ithuba lokufikelela kwiindawo ezintsha. Wayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayibhabha phezulu, igcwele ukuthembela kuThixo. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Iyeza ixesha lokuvuna, kuba isivuno somhlaba sivuthiwe.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Isivuno sivuthiwe. Kwiingqondo zethu, sicinga ngesivuno njengento elungileyo, kodwa xa sijongene nokulahleka komntwana, loo mazwi anokuvakala ebuhlungu. Kodwa uThixo akavuni nje ngenxa yokuthatha; uvuna ngenxa yokuba uthando lwakhe lufuna ukugcina okuxabisekileyo kwindawo apho kungekho ntlungu, kungekho zifo, kwaye kungekho mda.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesikhathi esinzima. Uthi: 'Qwalaselani umkhiwane nazo zonke ezinye imithi. Xa iintyatyambo zazo ziqala ukudubula, niyazi ukuba ihlobo lisondele.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ihlobo lisondele. Ngaba wakha waziva ngolo hlobo? Xa intlungu ikubambile, xa usizi luthatha indawo yovuyo, uvakalelwa kukuba uvalelwe entolongweni yosizi. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo, ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya.

UYesu uthi: 'Izulu nomhlaba ziya kudlula, kodwa amazwi am akayi kudlula.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Amazwi kaYesu akayi kudlula. Oku akuthethi ukuba asinakuphulukana nemizimba yethu. Kuthetha ukuba phambi kukaThixo, akakho umntu olahlekileyo. Yonke into oyithandayo, yonke into oyinikileyo, yonke into oyikhumbulayo ngoBen, igcinwe ngokupheleleyo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. 

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci.

Khumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen, eseneminyaka elishumi elinesihlanu, wathetha nabazali bakhe etsheho ukuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayesandula ukuhlaselwa zizifo ezimbini. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, kwaye yayingafuneki ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-insurance, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Alan noThao, nina bafazi namadoda abathandayo uBen, nina Ryan, mfowethu kaBen, hlalani neli themba. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci. 

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Nkqonkqozi engcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngokusemthethweni, nceda uze kum ngomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, kwaye ndizibophelela ngokupheleleyo kuwe. Musa ukuvumela ukuba ndahlulwe nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Nkosi, busisa aba bantwana bakho, ubaphe uxolo oludlula ukuqonda kwengqondo. Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela umphefumlo kaBen kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokukhanya kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abakhathazekileyo nabalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingunaphakade.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndabona ingelosi isihla ivela ezulwini, iphethe esandleni sayo isitshixo somhadi ongenamzantsi kunye nekhonkco elinzima. Yayibamba inamba, inyoka yakudala, enguMtyholi okanye uSathana, yamkhonkxa iminyaka eliwaka, yamphosa emhadini, yamvalela phezu kwayo, yamtywina, ukuze angaphindi alahlekise iintlanga kude kuphele iminyaka eliwaka. Emva koko, uya kukhululwa ixeshana elincinci. Ndabona iitron; abo babehleli kuzo baphathiswa ukugweba. Ndabona imiphefumlo yabo babenqunyulwe iintloko ngenxa yobungqina babo ngoYesu nangentetho kaThixo, nabo babengazange bakhonze isilo okanye umfanekiso waso, nabo babengamkelanga uphawu lwaso ebunzi okanye ezandleni zabo. Bavuka baphila, balawula kunye noKristu iminyaka eliwaka. Emva koko ndabona itrone enkulu emhlophe, nalowo wayehleli kuyo. Umhlaba nezulu zibaleka ebusweni bakhe, akwabakho ndawo kubo. Ndabona abafileyo, abakhulu nabancinci, bemi phambi kwetrone, kwavulwa imiqulu. Kwavulwa nomnye umqulu, incwadi yobomi. Abafileyo bagwetywa ngokwezenzo zabo, ngoko kubhalwe emiqulwini. Ulwandle lwanikela abafileyo balo; kwaza ukufa neHayidesi zikhupha abafileyo bazo. Bonke abafileyo bagwetywa ngokwezenzo zabo. Kwaza ukufa neHayidesi kwaphoswa echibini lomlilo. (Eli chiba lomlilo kukufa kwesibini.) Nabani na ogama lakhe lalingafumanekanga libhaliwe encwadini yobomi waphoswa echibini lomlilo. Ndabona izulu elitsha nomhlaba omtsha. Izulu lakudala nomhlaba wakudala zazidlulile, nolwandle lwalungasekho. Ndabona nesixeko esingcwele, iYerusalem entsha, isihla ivela ezulwini kuThixo, ilungiselelwe njengomtshakazi ohlotshiswele indoda yakhe.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe umzekeliso: “Qwalaselani umkhiwane nazo zonke ezinye imithi. Xa iintyatyambo zazo ziqala ukudubula, niyazi ukuba ihlobo lisondele; kwangokunjalo, xa nibona ezi zinto zisenzeka, yazini ukuba uBukumkani bukaThixo busondele. Inene, ndithi kuni, esi sizukulwana asiyi kudlula kude kwenzeke zonke ezi zinto. Izulu nomhlaba ziya kudlula, kodwa amazwi am akayi kudlula.”

day: Friday of the Thirty-fourth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Sad
pet_prayers.text: Miss you kid! We are in Taiwan right now. Thinking of you everywhere we go. Mom cries almost every day over here

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
